name: Bladmall
text: Bladmall is an alternate spelling for the sea-monster name Bledmall. In Irish the word Bledmall, along with the variants bladmall and bledmail, marks a fearsome deep-water creature. Several early Irish tales make mention of such underwater beasts. A reader who meets the form Bladmall should turn to the Bledmall entry for the fuller account.
